title: About Atlantis NDT — ASNT NDT Level III-Led NDT Company
description: Atlantis NDT is led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III. We build NDT reporting, ERP and digital twin software and deliver training and consulting.
intro: Atlantis NDT (Atlantis Engineering Consultants LLC) is a founder-led company offering NDT consulting, training, inspection services and inspection software. It is led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III.
story: Atlantis NDT gives inspection companies, fabricators and asset owners direct access to an ASNT NDT Level III for written practices, procedures, personnel qualification, training and audit support, without hiring a full-time Level III.

Alongside the consulting and training work, Atlantis builds software for inspection organisations: the Atlantis ERP, NDT reporting software, digital twin reporting and the Practical NDT simulation portal.

facts.label: ASNT NDT Level III
facts.text: Founder Anoop Rayavarapu holds ASNT NDT Level III certification in five methods: UT, RT, MT, PT and VT.

facts.label: Field experience
facts.text: 11+ years of international NDT field experience.

facts.label: NAS 410 Level 3
facts.text: Aerospace NAS 410 Level 3 services are delivered through an associate who holds NAS 410 Level 3.

facts.label: How we deliver
facts.text: Remotely, online, or on-site at your facility. Atlantis does not run training centres.

services.label: Level III consulting
services.text: Outsourced Level III, SNT-TC-1A written practices, procedure development and approval, and audit support.

services.label: NDT training
services.text: ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I, II and III training, delivered live online or on-site at your facility.

services.label: Inspection services
services.text: NDT field inspection with Level III-reviewed reports, delivered to your own inspector of record.

services.label: Atlantis ERP
services.text: Technician certifications, equipment calibration, jobs, quoting and invoicing in one system.

services.label: NDT reporting software
services.text: Field data capture and code-aligned NDT reports, standalone or as an ERP module.

services.label: Digital twin reporting
services.text: Inspection history shown on a navigable 3D model of the asset.

services.label: Practical NDT
services.text: Online practical NDT simulation for hands-on method practice.

values.title: Precision
values.text: Methods, procedures and acceptance criteria are set out in writing before work starts.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Work is done to the governing code and the client specification, with Level III review.

values.title: Expertise
values.text: Led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III, with hands-on field experience.

values.title: Innovation
values.text: Inspection software, digital twin reporting and practical NDT simulation alongside the consulting and training work.

contact: Email info@atlantisndt.com or use the contact page.
caseStudies: Two completed engagements are written up in full on the case studies page: a remote NDT documentation audit for a client in Qatar, and a UT weld inspection procedure updated to current code editions for LNG work. Client names are withheld.
